query:
let cohortEnd=datetime(2026-10-19T12:50:00Z); let calls=datatable(timestamp:datetime,caller:string,service:string,tool:string,outcome:string)[datetime(2026-10-19T12:00:00Z),'success','diagnostics','lookup_dns','validation_error',datetime(2026-10-19T12:01:00Z),'success','diagnostics','lookup_dns','tool_success',datetime(2026-10-19T12:00:00Z),'invalid','diagnostics','lookup_dns','validation_error',datetime(2026-10-19T12:01:00Z),'invalid','diagnostics','lookup_dns','validation_error',datetime(2026-10-19T12:02:00Z),'invalid','diagnostics','lookup_dns','tool_success',datetime(2026-10-19T12:00:00Z),'late','diagnostics','lookup_dns','validation_error',datetime(2026-10-19T12:11:00Z),'late','diagnostics','lookup_dns','tool_success',datetime(2026-10-19T12:00:00Z),'unknown','diagnostics','','validation_error',datetime(2026-10-19T12:00:00Z),'tie','diagnostics','lookup_dns','validation_error',datetime(2026-10-19T12:00:00Z),'tie','diagnostics','lookup_dns','tool_success',datetime(2026-10-19T12:59:00Z),'pending','diagnostics','lookup_dns','validation_error',datetime(2026-10-19T12:00:00Z),'other','diagnostics','lookup_dns','validation_error',datetime(2026-10-19T12:01:00Z),'other','diagnostics','lookup_dns','tool_error',datetime(2026-10-19T12:00:00Z),'alone','diagnostics','lookup_dns','validation_error',datetime(2026-10-19T12:01:00Z),'different','diagnostics','lookup_dns','tool_success']; calls | sort by caller asc,service asc,tool asc,timestamp asc | serialize
| extend nextTime=next(timestamp),nextCaller=next(caller),nextService=next(service),nextTool=next(tool),nextOutcome=next(outcome),previousTime=prev(timestamp),previousCaller=prev(caller),previousService=prev(service),previousTool=prev(tool)
| where outcome=='validation_error'
| extend matched= isnotempty(caller) and isnotempty(tool),mature=timestamp<cohortEnd, sameNext=caller==nextCaller and service==nextService and tool==nextTool
| extend ambiguous=matched and ((sameNext and nextTime==timestamp) or (caller==previousCaller and service==previousService and tool==previousTool and timestamp==previousTime)),retried=matched and sameNext and nextTime>timestamp and nextTime<=timestamp+10m
| extend result=case(not(mature),'pending',not(matched),'unmatchable',ambiguous,'ambiguous',not(retried),'no_observed_retry',nextOutcome=='tool_success','successful_retry',nextOutcome=='validation_error','invalid_retry','other_retry')
| summarize ValidationErrors=count(),Eligible=countif(result in ('successful_retry','invalid_retry','other_retry','no_observed_retry')),SuccessfulRetries=countif(result=='successful_retry'),InvalidRetries=countif(result=='invalid_retry'),OtherRetries=countif(result=='other_retry'),NoObservedRetry=countif(result=='no_observed_retry'),Pending=countif(result=='pending'),Unmatchable=countif(result=='unmatchable'),Ambiguous=countif(result=='ambiguous') by service,tool
| extend ObservedRetries=SuccessfulRetries+InvalidRetries+OtherRetries
| extend SuccessPerEligibleError=iff(Eligible>0,100.0*SuccessfulRetries/Eligible,real(null)),SuccessPerObservedRetry=iff(ObservedRetries>0,100.0*SuccessfulRetries/ObservedRetries,real(null))
